name: Magarpatta
civicNote: Within PMC limits in Hadapsar; internal services are run by the Magarpatta township company.
summary: A 182-hectare gated township in Hadapsar, east Pune, built from 2000 onwards, combining housing with the Cybercity office complex.
knownFor: Magarpatta Cybercity, a 12-tower IT and office complex
Gated township run by Magarpatta Township Development & Construction Co.
Seasons Mall on the township's outskirts
connectivity: Located in Hadapsar, near NH65 (Pune-Solapur highway)
Hadapsar railway station serves the area
suits: Professionals working in Cybercity and families who want a planned, gated township.
